title: Elasticsearch

fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS Sigv4 Authentication for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role specified with aws_role_arn.

fields.name: aws_profile
fields.description: AWS profile name.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: Specify the AWS region for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: AWS IAM Role to assume to put records to your Amazon cluster.

fields.name: aws_service_name
fields.description: Service name to use in AWS Sigv4 signature.

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify the custom STS endpoint to be used with STS API for Amazon OpenSearch Service.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Specify the buffer size used to read the response from the Elasticsearch HTTP service.

fields.name: cloud_auth
fields.description: Specify the credentials to use to connect to Elastic's Elasticsearch Service running on Elastic Cloud.

fields.name: cloud_id
fields.description: If using Elastic's Elasticsearch Service you can specify the cloud_id of the cluster running.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism.

fields.name: current_time_index
fields.description: Use current time for index generation instead of message record.

fields.name: generate_id
fields.description: When enabled, generate _id for outgoing records.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target Elasticsearch instance.

fields.name: http_api_key
fields.description: API key for authenticating with Elasticsearch.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Password for user defined in http_user.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Optional username credential for Elastic X-Pack access.

fields.name: id_key
fields.description: If set, _id will be the value of the key from the incoming record and generate_id option is ignored.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: When enabled, appends the Tag name to the record.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Index name.

fields.name: logstash_dateformat
fields.description: Time format based on [strftime](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/strftime.3.html) to generate the second part of the Index name.

fields.name: logstash_format
fields.description: Enable Logstash format compatibility.

fields.name: logstash_prefix
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, the Index name is composed using a prefix and the date.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_key
fields.description: When included, the value of the key in the record is evaluated as a key reference and overrides logstash_prefix for index generation.

fields.name: logstash_prefix_separator
fields.description: Set a separator between logstash_prefix and date.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Elasticsearch accepts new data on HTTP query path /_bulk.

fields.name: pipeline
fields.description: Define which pipeline the database should use.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target Elasticsearch instance.

fields.name: replace_dots
fields.description: When enabled, replace field name dots with underscore.

fields.name: suppress_type_name
fields.description: When enabled, mapping types is removed and type option is ignored.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: When include_tag_key is enabled, this property defines the key name for the tag.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, each record will get a new timestamp field.

fields.name: time_key_format
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, this property defines the format of the timestamp.

fields.name: time_key_nanos
fields.description: When logstash_format is enabled, enabling this property sends nanosecond precision timestamps.

fields.name: trace_error
fields.description: If Elasticsearch returns an error, print the Elasticsearch API request and response for diagnostics.

fields.name: trace_output
fields.description: Print all Elasticsearch API request payloads to stdout for diagnostics.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type name.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/4.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: write_operation
fields.description: Operation type for records.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Elasticsearch (es) output plugin lets you ingest your records into an Elasticsearch database.
